_provenance: Hand-written hazard memories (labelled; not agent-recorded). Each states an OUTDATED version of a TK family's team knowledge, as an older colleague memory would. Loaded with created_at backdated by ageDays so BAB reports them as old (verify: true). Used by conditions ST (stale only) and CF (stale + the colleague's current learning).

learnings.title: Ledgerly import format: comma-separated, ISO dates, marker line #LEDGERLY,1
learnings.body: Ledgerly (Finance's ERP) imports CSV files whose first line is the marker `#LEDGERLY,1`, then the header row, comma-separated, ISO dates (YYYY-MM-DD) and amounts with a dot and two decimals. E104 'invalid record at line 1' means the marker line is missing.

learnings.title: Shipfast signatures: X-Shipfast-Signature = sha256=<HMAC of raw body>
learnings.body: Shipfast verifies requests and webhooks with the header `X-Shipfast-Signature: sha256=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body>`. A 401 'signature verification failed' almost always means the body was re-serialised after signing: sign exactly the bytes you send.

learnings.title: geo-api client: retry 429 and 503 using Retry-After, up to 10 times
learnings.body: geo-api (platform's geocoding service) answers 429 when rate limited and 503 during short deploy blips. Honour the standard Retry-After header (seconds) on both and retry up to 10 times.

learnings.title: Kestrel Bank settlement cut-off is 15:00 UTC on weekdays
learnings.body: Kestrel Bank settles card captures made before 15:00 UTC on a weekday that same day; later captures settle the next weekday. Settlement statement dates are UTC dates.

learnings.title: Orion CRM customer numbers use a Luhn check digit
learnings.body: Orion CRM customer numbers look like C-NNNNN-K, where K is a Luhn check digit over the five digits. Only the C-NNNNN-K form is valid.

learnings.title: Postbird: marketing mail needs X-Postbird-Category: marketing
learnings.body: Postbird filters bulk mail that is not labelled. Set the header `X-Postbird-Category: marketing` on newsletters and promos; nothing else is needed.

learnings.title: Internal service tokens: which claims to check
learnings.body: Service-to-service tokens from the internal identity service: iss is https://auth.acme.example, aud is the bare service name (e.g. reports), the granted scopes are in the `scopes` list claim, and exp is checked strictly (no clock-skew leeway).

learnings.title: Paylane charges: integer cents, uppercase currency
learnings.body: Paylane takes `amount` as an integer number of cents (amount * 100) for every currency and `currency` as the uppercase ISO 4217 code (EUR).
